newsitem.title: USA: Eskimo Pie earnings fall sharply.
newsitem.headline: Eskimo Pie earnings fall sharply.

text.p: Eskimo Pie Corp., the maker of ice cream bars and other frozen treats, said Friday its earnings fell sharply in the first quarter.
The Richmond, Va.-based company said its earnings fell to $53,000, or 2 cents a share in the first quarter, from $1.1 million, or 31 cents a share, a year earlier
Sales fell to $18.1 million from $19.8 million.
"These results, while below the comparable period in 1996, are in line with our internal and the market's expectations for 1997 following the $2 million loss in 1996," said Chairman Arnold Dreyfuss.
"Meeting our goals in what is generally a slow time of the year in our seasonal business provides encouragement for the future," he said in a statement.
For all of 1996, the company reported a loss of $2 million, or 59 cents a share, on sales of $74.1 million.

Eskimo Pie introduced the Eskimo Pie ice cream bar in 1921, and now makes frozen yogurt, ice cream and sorbet under the Eskimo Pie, Welch's, Weight Watchers and other names. Eskimo Pie stock was unchanged at $12.125 on Nasdaq in early afternoon trading.
